data.title: Mobile Developer
data.summary: The role involves developing iOS and Android mobile applications, including digital identity and credential features. It also covers mobile security functions such as NFC, biometrics and secure storage.

requirements.text: At least five years of iOS and/or Android mobile development experience
requirements.question: Would someone who has done mobile application development, with fewer than 5 years, be worth a conversation?
requirements.why: The posting asks for extensive prior mobile application development experience.

requirements.text: Experience from at least five completed iOS and Android mobile projects
Experience with digital identity, eID, mobile wallets or digital credentials
Experience implementing mobile security features and secure data storage

requirements.question: Is Finnish needed from day one, or could someone start in English and build up Finnish on the job?
requirements.why: The posting makes fluent spoken and written Finnish mandatory.
